title: The notice for a self-started Claude turn opened while a prompt waits says it runs beside that prompt's turn, even when the prompt then takes it up
outcome: The transcript notice for a self-started turn that was not adopted because a prompt is in progress does not claim it is separate from that prompt's turn when the prompt's start, output or result then takes it up (adjust the notice, or add a notice at take-up).
acceptance: A self-started turn opened while a prompt waits, then taken up by that prompt, leaves no transcript notice saying the turn is not part of the prompt's turn; covered by a test.
The maintained full gate passes on the change.
